column1: FAAB — $100 SEASON FREE-AGENT BUDGET (in-season waiver bidding; separate from the draft)

column2: Most FAAB league-winners are backup RBs who fall into a starting job (injury or benching). Spend your biggest bids there, not on WRs.
This is when breakout RB/WRs first surface and roles shift. Pounce on real opportunity — but don't empty the tank.
Rarely go over ~$30-40 on one player unless it's a clear league-winner (a true every-down bell-cow RB).
Hold ~$25-30 into the fantasy playoff push (Wks 12-14) for an injury replacement or a great matchup streamer.
Bid $17 or $23, never round numbers — you edge out everyone parked on $15 / $20.
No kicker in this league. Defenses and one-week fill-ins are $0-2 bids — stream the matchup, never pay up.
Let roles settle a week or two before spending on preseason hype or one big game.
